subject: mirtCAT does not save item_time on the server side

messages.author: cd0ebcb57b88c479
messages.subject: mirtCAT does not save item_time on the server side
parts:
Hi Phil,
I'm working on a project that includes implementing an adaptive test on the AWS using mirtCAT.

We've successfully got test takers' responses from 'person' object by customizing the final function (briefly, save person object and write it to a separate rds file)

But we found that the each user's response time for an item, 'item_time', was not saved but gave all 0s.

We checked that it was saved adequately when we ran the shinyapp locally and took the test. 

Do you have any ideas on this issue, and possibly good solution?

Thanks,
Jungmin
